items.question: Do I have to pay to speak with an advisor?
items.answer: No. Your initial consultation is completely free and comes with no obligation.

items.question: Can you help me compare multiple plans?
items.answer: Yes. We help you review options from trusted carriers so you can make an informed decision.

items.question: Is my information secure?
items.answer: Yes. Your information is handled securely and only used to assist you with coverage options.

items.question: Can you help if I already have coverage?
items.answer: Absolutely. We can review your current coverage and help determine whether a better option may be available.

items.question: How long does the process take?
items.answer: Most consultations take 15-30 minutes depending on your needs.

items.question: What types of coverage can you help with?
items.answer: We can help with individual, family, prescription, hospital, specialist, and related health coverage options.
